query:
SELECT j::date AS "jour!"
             FROM event.events e,
                  LATERAL generate_series(
                      (e.starts_at AT TIME ZONE e.timezone::text)::date,
                      (e.ends_at   AT TIME ZONE e.timezone::text)::date,
                      interval '1 day') AS j
            WHERE e.id = $1
            ORDER BY 1
